standard_prerequisites.use: Affineness of point-closed maps locally of finite type (Morphisms, lemma-homeomorphism-affine), the affine-space test for relative pseudo-coherence (same chapter), and invariance under closed pushforwards (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-closed-push-pseudo-coherent).

core_obligations: Reduce to affine rings with a surjection on Jacobson-radical quotients.
Construct the nilpotent-thickened intermediate affine space T.
Transfer pseudo-coherence along the zigzag via the two cited invariances.

proof_roadmap.step: Algebra model with generators killed to nilpotence.
Equivalence chain through pushforwards to affine spaces.

difficulty_reason: Let i : X -> Y be a map of schemes over S, each locally of finite type over S, inducing a homeomorphism of X with a closed subset of Y; then E in D(O_X) is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S if and only if Ri_*E is so. The retained proof is written out: i is affine (Morphisms, lemma-homeomorphism-affine), reduce to affines S = Spec R, Y = Spec A, X = Spec B with A/rad -> B/rad surjective; choose algebra generators of B over A inside the radical with nilpotent powers and build the intermediate ring R[x_i, y_j]/(y_j^N) and the corresponding diagram of affine spaces over S; then walk the equivalence through the chapter's characterization of relative pseudo-coherence via pushforward to affine space (lemma-relative-pseudo-coherence-characterize) and the closed-immersion push-pull invariance (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-closed-push-pseudo-coherent) along the zigzag X -> T -> A^{n+m}_S and Y -> A^n_S. Retained author proof at lines 16957-16992.

dedup.scope: Detection of relative pseudo-coherence along a map that is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset.
